title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Mark 13: the temple buildings, the signs of the end, the Son of Man coming in clouds and the call to watch.

questions.text: What did Jesus say would happen to the great buildings a disciple pointed out?
questions.explanation: A disciple admired the stones and the buildings, and Jesus said that not one stone would be left on another that would not be thrown down.

answers.text: Not one stone would be left on another
They would be made of gold
They would be given to the nations

questions.text: Who asked him privately on the Mount of Olives when these things would be?
questions.explanation: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately about these things.

questions.text: What did Jesus call the wars, earthquakes and famines he described?
questions.explanation: He said nation will rise against nation and there will be earthquakes, famines and troubles, and that these things are the beginning of birth pains.

questions.text: According to Jesus, what must happen first?
questions.explanation: He said that the Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

answers.text: The temple must be rebuilt in Jerusalem
The abomination of desolation must be taken away
The Good News must be preached to all the nations
Every nation must come up to the temple

questions.text: Who did Jesus say would speak when they were led away and delivered up?
questions.explanation: He told them not to be anxious beforehand about what to say, because it is not they who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the one who endures to the end?
questions.explanation: He said they would be hated by all men for his name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

answers.text: He will be given a throne
He will see the temple rebuilt

questions.text: What were those in Judea to do when they saw the abomination of desolation standing where it ought not?
questions.explanation: He said that then those who are in Judea should flee to the mountains.

questions.text: What did Jesus say would happen in the sky in those days, after that oppression?
questions.explanation: He said the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.

answers.text: A new star would rise over the earth
Fire would fall on the earth from heaven
The sun would be darkened and the stars would fall
The sky would be rolled up like a scroll

questions.text: What does the fig tree show when its branch becomes tender and produces leaves?
questions.explanation: He told them to learn from the fig tree: when the branch becomes tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

answers.text: That the tree will be cut down

questions.text: Who did Jesus say knows that day or that hour?
questions.explanation: He said that of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
